---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Motivation
Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve?

## 🎯 Use Case
Describe a specific scenario where this feature would be useful.

**Example:**
As a [type of user], I want [goal] so that [benefit].

## ✨ Proposed Solution
How do you envision this feature working?

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Have you thought of alternative solutions? If so, describe them.

## 📊 Impact Assessment

**Areas Affected:**
- [ ] Backend API
- [ ] Database schema
- [ ] Embedded devices
- [ ] DevOps/Infrastructure
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Testing

**Priority:**
- [ ] Critical - Blocks core functionality
- [ ] High - Significantly improves UX/performance
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor improvement

## 🎨 Design/Mockups (Optional)
Add any design mockups, diagrams, or wireframes.

## 📋 Acceptance Criteria
What needs to be done for this feature to be considered complete?

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Tests written
- [ ] Documentation updated

## 🔗 Related Issues/PRs
Link to related issues or pull requests.

## 📚 Additional Context
Any other context, references, or examples.

## 🤔 Questions
Any questions or uncertainties about this feature?
